info.cls_ename: RMIT-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business and Innovation

description.describe_ch: In the Innovation Project 1 and 2 (Design-driven Innovation 1 and 2) course, students develop research skills that support an innovation mindset and the competencies required to implement a design-driven innovation process. During this course, students are introduced to innovation theories and useful frameworks that explain the incremental and radical innovation of products, services, and experiences. Students then learn to explore the socio-cultural contexts and factors that underlie a design situation to frame a problem to solve or a potential opportunity, and create a design approach that leads to true novelty. To achieve this, students work in teams to conduct crucial design research, develop and communicate a design framework, prototype the proposed innovation, and produce a video depicting the innovation’s benefits in context.
